_description: E-043f: the DAILY codec — 512x12, 4 heads, d_dec 256, d_z 32, patch 1 on family5_na025_daily (39 channels, T=15,706, 165.6 GB fp16) — with NO LONGITUDE HOLDOUT. Architecturally identical to f4-40M and f4r2-40M; the only differences are the tensor's cadence and holdout_lon '0,0', so the -45..-25 block trains instead of being withheld. This exists because the daily track had NO recipe at all: #389 and #400/#410 each hand-assembled the architecture from 25 dispatch fields, which is exactly the copying exercise ml/CLAUDE.md section 1 forbids, and it is why arm F of this wave could not be dispatched until the recipe was written. WHY '0,0' AND NOT 'none': [0,0) is the empty half-open interval, so the mask is bit-identical to what 'none' produces, but twelve eval scripts under ml/ still re-read ck['args']['holdout_lon'] with float() and would lose the whole probe ladder to a ValueError swallowed by a best-effort guard — a green run with an empty probe archive. See f3-anchor-41M-nolonhold.json for the list and the follow-up that makes 'none' safe. DISPATCH WITH `resume` EMPTY (a recipe cannot pin resume — the seed step reads inputs.resume in an `if:`, a YAML expression context $RECIPE_RESUME cannot reach). THIS RUN GOES ON THE 700 GB BOX ONLY: it is the only box holding the built f5r1 tensor, train.py takes a full 165.6 GB writable scratch copy on top of it, and the daily probe ladder has never been exercised at this scale. HEAD_PROBE IS 'true' HERE EXPLICITLY (2026-08-21). The workflow's default is now true as well, so this key changes nothing about what runs — it states it, because a recipe is the record of a configuration that was RUN and 'which read-out produced the verdict' is now part of that configuration. ml/CLAUDE.md §3: unpooled is the verdict, the pooled ridge is a labelled legacy comparable, and both sides of a comparison switch together (the head's raw-3x3 and wind-only bars are fitted in the same loop, scripts/probes_run.sh).
_provenance: Architecture read verbatim from probes-389.json's provenance on the ml-metrics branch (the E-038c dispatch): tensor family5_na025_daily, d_z 32, patch 1, 512x12, heads 4, d_dec 256, anomaly true, batch 512, steps 200000, eval_every 7500, light_probe_every 10000, temporal_steps 0, window global, resume unset. Two runs at this configuration have been measured and neither finished. #389 wedged 7 h in the per-channel anomaly transform (249 full-extent strided traversals, ~41 TB of physical read against a 64 GB box) and was cancelled; the transform is now time-chunked to 6 traversals, bit-identical (commit aea7d63). #400/#410 then trained cleanly at 216.6 ms/step but were cancelled at step 67,000/200,000 when this regime change was decided — its last full probe (step 60,000) read linear_r_deseas 0.582, linear_r_raw 0.602, temporal_r_deseas 0.627, chan_vs_persistence 28.1%, and its linear_r_deseas was flat in 0.558-0.598 across the whole run with no trend. Probes are 65% of wall clock at daily cadence (a full eval is ~2,300 s against 216.6 ms/step training), which is the dominant cost term to watch. NOTHING HAS BEEN RUN AT THIS CONFIGURATION YET — the holdout_lon field is new; this recipe is the dispatch surface, and its _provenance becomes a measurement when the run lands.
